health_predicates.healthy: zero missed heartbeats AND lag_seconds<=120 AND parser_valid AND transport_live
health_predicates.degraded: transport_live AND (exactly one missed heartbeat OR 120<lag_seconds<=600)
health_predicates.down: authenticated collector_or_transport_stop OR at least two consecutive missed heartbeats

detector_availability_resolution.feature_eligibility_precedence: before calibration lookup, eligible_detector_count=0 forces kappa=out_of_support, decision_eligible=false, eligibility_reason=no_eligible_detector_value, and P=null even when resolved states are no_detection

assembly.array_order_rule: application sorts arrays by canonical_reference_order before RFC8785; JCS preserves array element order
assembly.reference_sentinel: optional absence uses {reference_kind:sentinel,relation,dependency_group,sentinel_reason,expected_object_id}; required absence is missing_input
assembly.finite_number_rule: reject NaN, Infinity, -Infinity, negative zero, and binary64 overflow
assembly.health_snapshot_source: dereference SupportDecision.ordered_coverage_references; Assembler cannot independently select health

labels_and_matching.benign_contamination: |episode_action_tokens intersect registered_benign_tokens| / |(episode_action_tokens intersect selected_group_tokens) union (episode_action_tokens intersect registered_benign_tokens)|; zero denominator is undefined
labels_and_matching.group_selection: descending action_coverage then descending edge_weight then ascending UTF-8 group_id; no edge gives g_star=null, action_coverage=0, contamination=undefined
labels_and_matching.truth_conflict: overlapping groups assign one root/action token to different IDs OR one root is malicious and benign OR duplicate offline receipt IDs disagree on card/window
labels_and_matching.string_id_order: ascending unsigned UTF-8 bytes; identifiers are ASCII-constrained by schema
labels_and_matching.one_to_one_assignment_scope: episode precision recall and F1 only
labels_and_matching.offline_label_join: after terminal AssemblyOutcome insertion, resolve EpisodeRevision by digest and label AuditRecord or AssemblyFailureRecord; unresolved revision is ambiguous

decision_populations.C_dec_binary: C_dec_score with offline label positive or negative

labels_and_matching.failure_bias_reporting: RT1 counts each terminal outcome type and AssemblyFailureRecord by positive, negative, mixed, ambiguous label over C_dec_all

calibration_group_gate.fold_assignment_unit: complete run; no run crosses folds
calibration_group_gate.fold_sort: descending (positive_count+negative_count), then ascending SHA-256(UTF8('20260710')||0x1f||group_key||0x1f||run_id), then run_id UTF-8
calibration_group_gate.fold_assignment: for each sorted run r and fold f compute resulting loads P_f=(pos_f+pos_r)/P_total, N_f=(neg_f+neg_r)/N_total, R_f=(runs_f+1)/R_total; choose ascending (max(P_f,N_f,R_f),P_f+N_f+R_f,f); require every fold nonempty
calibration_group_gate.fold_assignment_artifact: ordered {group_key,run_id,positive_count,negative_count,fold} array plus SHA-256 over RFC8785 bytes
